nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Empty package marker file that makes soa_builder.mcp a Python package for the MCP server module.

nodes.name: server.py
nodes.summary: MCP (Model Context Protocol) server exposing 11 tools over stdio for interacting with the SoA workbench: listing/creating SoAs, visits, and activities, assigning activities to scheduled instances, retrieving the visits-by-activities matrix, and generating USDM/Define-JSON documents. Registered as the `soa-mcp` console script and picked up by Claude Code via `.mcp.json`.
nodes.languageNotes: Tool handlers are dispatched through a name-to-function lookup table (_dispatch); DB access reuses soa_builder.web.db._connect and heavier USDM/Define-JSON generation is lazily imported inside handlers to avoid unnecessary import-time cost.

nodes.name: _dispatch
nodes.summary: Routes an incoming MCP tool call by name to its corresponding private handler function, raising ValueError for unknown tool names.

nodes.name: _list_soas
nodes.summary: Handler for the list_soas MCP tool; queries the database for all Schedules of Activities and returns their id, name, study_id, study_label, and created_at.

nodes.name: _create_soa
nodes.summary: Handler for the create_soa MCP tool; validates the required name argument, inserts a new Schedule of Activities row, and commits or rolls back the transaction on error.

nodes.name: _get_soa
nodes.summary: Handler for the get_soa MCP tool; fetches metadata for a single Schedule of Activities by id, raising ValueError if not found.

nodes.name: _list_visits
nodes.summary: Handler for the list_visits MCP tool; returns the visit definitions belonging to a given Schedule of Activities.

nodes.name: _create_visit
nodes.summary: Handler for the create_visit MCP tool; validates visit name/label/type, computes the next monotonic visit UID, and inserts the new visit row within a transaction.

nodes.name: _list_activities
nodes.summary: Handler for the list_activities MCP tool; returns study activities defined for a given Schedule of Activities.

nodes.name: _create_activity
nodes.summary: Handler for the create_activity MCP tool; validates activity name/label/description, computes the next monotonic activity UID, and inserts the new activity row within a transaction.

nodes.name: _assign_instance_activity
nodes.summary: Handler for the assign_instance_activity MCP tool; marks an activity as scheduled at a given Scheduled Activity Instance, updating status and committing the change.

nodes.name: _get_soa_matrix
nodes.summary: Handler for the get_soa_matrix MCP tool; builds and returns the visits-by-activities matrix for a Schedule of Activities by joining visit, activity, and assignment data.

nodes.name: _get_usdm_json
nodes.summary: Handler for the get_usdm_json MCP tool; validates the requested USDM component name against the allowed list and delegates generation to the web usdm_json router's _build helper.

nodes.name: _get_define_json
nodes.summary: Handler for the get_define_json MCP tool; validates the sdtmct/sdtmig arguments and delegates to build_define_json to produce a Define-JSON document.

nodes.name: bc_explorer.js
nodes.summary: Client-side script driving the CDISC Biomedical Concept (BC) Grouping Explorer UI: filters and renders BC cards/matrix views by scheme facets and search query, and manages a detail panel showing related concepts. Consumes a server-seeded global `BC_DATA` object rather than fetching or importing data itself.
nodes.languageNotes: Adapted from a standalone prototype; templates render partials via string interpolation directly into innerHTML rather than using a framework.

nodes.name: bcMatchesSearch
nodes.summary: Determines whether a Biomedical Concept matches the current search query by checking its short name, id, NCIt code, and the labels/descriptions of its assigned grouping values.

nodes.name: getFilteredBcs
nodes.summary: Returns the list of Biomedical Concepts that satisfy both the active search query and the active facet filters (grouped by scheme, ANDed across schemes, ORed within a scheme).

nodes.name: getValueCountForFiltered
nodes.summary: Computes how many currently-filtered Biomedical Concepts are tagged with a given facet value, used to render live counts next to each facet checkbox.

nodes.name: renderFacets
nodes.summary: Renders the facet sidebar (grouping schemes and their values with live counts), and wires up click handlers for collapsing scheme groups, toggling filters, clearing filters, and showing zero-count facets.

nodes.name: renderExplorer
nodes.summary: Renders the card-grid Explorer view of filtered Biomedical Concepts with highlighted search matches and wires up click handlers to open the detail panel for a selected concept.

nodes.name: renderMatrix
nodes.summary: Renders the grouped Matrix view organizing filtered Biomedical Concepts by scheme and facet value, and wires up interactions for jumping to concept detail or filtering by a clicked value.

nodes.name: openDetail
nodes.summary: Opens the detail panel for a given Biomedical Concept, grouping its assigned facet values by scheme and listing other concepts that share at least one facet value, with click-through navigation.

nodes.name: bc_groupings.html
nodes.summary: Standalone pandoc-generated help page explaining Biomedical Concept Groupings: how groups tag related BCs, are created at the UX layer independent of any single SoA, can be assigned to or removed from an Activity, and support copy/inheritance between groups.

nodes.name: bc_workflow.html
nodes.summary: Standalone pandoc-generated help page walking through the workflow for linking a Biomedical Concept (and Biomedical Concept Surrogate) to an Activity/Scheduled Activity Instance in the SoA Matrix, illustrated with screenshots.

nodes.name: style.css
nodes.summary: Shared design-system stylesheet for the whole soa-workbench web UI, defining the `am-` (atomic utility) and `fz-` (freeze/component) class conventions used across templates: layout grids, form controls, buttons, data tables, change/audit cards, and spacing/typography utilities.
nodes.languageNotes: Organized into clearly demarcated sections (e.g. amendment cards, freeze pages, objectives/endpoints, audit modals, utility atomics) following the approved am-/fz- class convention documented in the project's UI style guide feedback.

nodes.name: usdm_json.html
nodes.summary: Jinja template rendering the USDM JSON generation page for a study: a table of downloadable USDM components (arms, activities, encounters, etc.) each linking to its component-specific JSON download endpoint.

nodes.name: usdm_model_explorer.html
nodes.summary: Self-contained interactive USDM v4.0.0 Model Explorer page embedding the full USDM class/attribute reference data inline as a JSON literal (sourced from dataStructure.yml, USDM_UML.xmi, USDM_API JSON, USDM_CT.xlsx, and the LZZT pilot study), with its own browse/search UI and scoped styling independent of the shared app stylesheet.
nodes.languageNotes: Embeds a large static data literal plus scoped CSS custom properties (--blue, --purple, etc.) rather than relying on the shared style.css design system, making the widget portable/self-contained.
